title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
abstract: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: this https URL.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate course called Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotics, today’s lecture is on “A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control.” Work such as “Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning” shows how broad simulator resets can support robot learning, while sim-to-real robotics research is expanding toward physical deployment. This paper, from researchers at the University of Washington and NVIDIA, asks how to allocate experience within those resets. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设的研究生课程“机器人深度强化学习”中，今天的讲座主题是“均衡的数据食谱：解决机器人控制中超大规模强化学习的探索瓶颈”。像“通过多样重置和大规模强化学习实现涌现灵巧性”这样的工作展示了广泛的模拟器重置如何支持机器人学习，而sim-to-real机器人研究正在向物理部署扩展。这篇论文来自华盛顿大学和NVIDIA的研究人员，探讨的是如何在这些重置中分配经验。诺亚，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does sampling matter if we can just run more simulated environments?
segments.zh: 教授您好，既然我们可以直接跑更多的模拟环境，为什么采样还这么重要呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because more simulation is useful only when it produces informative experience. With uniform sampling, a large batch may contain many episodes from configurations the policy already solves, or configurations it is nowhere near solving. Both can offer little learning signal. The paper’s central idea is to spend more training time on configurations where the policy has a reasonable chance of succeeding, while still revisiting easier and harder cases.
segments.zh: 因为只有当模拟能产生有信息量的经验时，更多的模拟才有用。在均匀采样下，一大批数据里可能有很多回合来自策略已经能解决的配置，或者来自它根本还搞不定的配置。这两种情况能提供的学习信号都很有限。这篇论文的核心思路，是把更多训练时间花在策略有合理机会成功的配置上，同时仍然会回顾更简单和更难的案例。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The method is called Success Guided Sampling, or S-G-S. Before training, the researchers create a fixed set of task configurations. A configuration can specify a robot’s starting state, its goal, and details such as terrain or object placement. The sampler tracks recent outcomes for each configuration, then uses those success estimates to adjust how likely each one is to be selected at the next reset.
segments.zh: 这个方法叫成功引导采样，简称S-G-S。训练之前，研究者会先创建一组固定的任务配置。一个配置可以指定机器人的初始状态、目标，以及地形或物体摆放等细节。采样器会追踪每个配置最近的结果，然后用这些成功率的估计来调整每个配置在下一次重置时被选中的概率。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does the sampler remove configurations that are too easy or too difficult?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这个采样器会把太简单或太难的配置去掉吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. S-G-S favors configurations near a chosen target success rate, but easy and difficult configurations keep some chance of being selected. That matters because the policy may improve, making a difficult case learnable, or may need continued practice on an easier one. The method uses a beta-shaped weighting and a softmax to turn recent success estimates into selection probabilities; it does not prescribe a hand-ordered sequence.
segments.zh: 不会。S-G-S更倾向于选择成功率接近目标值的配置，但简单和困难的配置仍有一定概率被选中。这一点很重要，因为策略可能会进步，让原本困难的案例变得可学习，也可能需要在较简单的案例上持续练习。该方法使用beta形权重和softmax，把最近的成功率估计转化为选择概率；它并不预设一个手工排好的顺序。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The team tests locomotion across 13 terrain types with a quadruped, and manipulation across assembly tasks such as threading a nut onto a bolt and inserting a rod. At one million parallel environments, locomotion success averages 73% with S-G-S, compared with 54% for P-L-R. For Franka nut-and-bolt assembly, S-G-S reaches 70%, while uniform sampling and P-L-R reach 6% and 5%.
segments.zh: 团队用四足机器人测试了13种地形上的运动能力，还测试了装配类操作任务，比如把螺母拧到螺栓上、插入一根杆。在一百万个并行环境下，S-G-S的运动成功率平均达到73%，而P-L-R只有54%。在Franka螺母螺栓装配任务中，S-G-S达到70%，而均匀采样和P-L-R分别只有6%和5%。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what makes the comparison fair across so many different tasks?
segments.zh: 你能说清楚在这么多不同任务之间，比较的公平性是怎么保证的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The researchers use P-P-O and compact policies based on state information. They share one reward function across locomotion tasks and another across manipulation tasks, rather than designing a separate reward for every terrain or assembly. They also use no demonstrations during reinforcement learning. The sampler changes how often pre-generated configurations appear; it neither invents new tasks nor replaces the reset-generation process.
segments.zh: 研究者用的是PPO和基于状态信息的紧凑策略。他们在运动任务之间共用一个奖励函数，在操作任务之间共用另一个，而不是为每种地形或装配单独设计奖励。强化学习过程中也没有使用任何演示数据。采样器改变的是预生成配置出现的频率，它既不创造新任务，也不替代重置生成的过程。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The results suggest that the benefit depends on task difficulty, not simply on scale. In a rod-in-hole experiment, S-G-S learns at 32,000 environments when uniform sampling and P-L-R achieve zero success; at 256,000, all methods approach 98%. On UR5e nut-and-bolt assembly, S-G-S reaches 90.04%, compared with 48.83% for uniform sampling. Removing near-goal resets prevents learning in a rod-in-hole ablation.
segments.zh: 结果表明，收益取决于任务难度，而不只是规模。在插杆入孔实验中，均匀采样和P-L-R在32000个环境时成功率为零，而S-G-S能学起来；到256000个环境时，所有方法都接近98%。在UR5e螺母螺栓装配任务上，S-G-S达到90.04%，而均匀采样只有48.83%。在插杆入孔的消融实验中，去掉接近目标的复位会让学习无法进行。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the sampler can focus learning, but it still depends on having useful starting states available?
segments.zh: 所以采样器可以聚焦学习，但它仍然依赖于有可用的有效起始状态吧？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The manipulation pipeline also tests physical transfer. The team trains point-cloud policies in simulation, then uses dataset aggregation to distill them into policies that take R-G-B images from wrist and third-person cameras. The resulting policies run on hardware without real-world fine-tuning. Success varies by task: 37.5% for nut-and-bolt assembly, 61% for rod insertion, and 94% for gear-mesh insertion.
segments.zh: 确实如此。这个操作流程还测试了物理迁移。团队在仿真中训练点云策略，然后用数据集聚合把它们蒸馏成接收腕部摄像头和第三人称摄像头RGB图像的策略。最终得到的策略无需真实世界微调就能在硬件上运行。成功率因任务而异：螺母螺栓装配为37.5%，插杆为61%，齿轮啮合插入为94%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This work builds on the broader idea of diverse resets, seen in “Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning,” and examines a different bottleneck: how to choose among available resets. Prioritized Level Replay and Sampling for Learnability also use learnability-oriented sampling. The authors do not claim that prioritizing moderately difficult cases is a new principle; their contribution is testing a simple success-based implementation in large-scale, contact-rich robotics.
segments.zh: 这项工作建立在更广泛的多样化重置思路之上，也就是“通过多样化重置和大规模强化学习实现涌现灵巧性”里提出的那套想法，只不过它考察的是另一个瓶颈：在可选的重置方式中该怎么挑。Prioritized Level Replay 和 Sampling for Learnability 也用了面向可学习性的采样。作者并没有说优先选中等难度的案例是什么新原理；他们的贡献在于，在大规模、富接触的机器人任务里测试了一个简单的、基于成功率的实现。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What should researchers be cautious about when applying this approach to new domains?
segments.zh: 研究者在把这个方法应用到新领域时，应该注意哪些问题？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: First, S-G-S stores estimates for a discrete set of configurations, which may not scale cleanly to continuous or enormous task spaces. Second, it selects configurations but does not generate them, so missing a crucial reset can still block learning. And third, strong simulated performance does not guarantee reliable hardware performance: the real-world results vary substantially across tasks, especially for nut and rod assembly.
segments.zh: 首先，S-G-S 存储的是一组离散配置的估计值，这可能无法顺利扩展到连续或超大的任务空间。其次，它只负责选择配置，而不生成配置，所以一旦漏掉某个关键的复位状态，学习仍然可能卡住。第三，仿真中表现强劲，并不保证硬件上也能稳定复现：真实世界的结果在不同任务之间差异很大，尤其是螺母和杆件装配任务。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader lesson is that scaling robot reinforcement learning involves more than adding parallel environments. Researchers also need to consider whether each episode is useful and whether the reset distribution covers the states that matter. S-G-S offers one practical way to adapt that allocation without a manually ordered curriculum, while leaving reset generation and sim-to-real reliability as open problems. A balanced data diet helps, but it cannot make missing experience appear. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 更广泛的启示是，扩展机器人强化学习不只是增加并行环境那么简单。研究者还需要考虑每个回合是否有用，以及重置分布是否覆盖了真正重要的状态。S-G-S 提供了一种实用的方式，无需人工编排课程就能调整这种分配，但重置生成和仿真到现实的可靠性仍然是未解决的问题。均衡的数据配比有帮助，但它无法让缺失的经验凭空出现。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以询问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
